ns2:course.label: Social Work and the Law
ns2:course.description: Legal procedures and issues of special relevance to social work practice; includes legal provisions related to poverty, family development and crises, racial and ethnic minorities, institutionalized persons, crime and delinquency, legal authority of social agencies, and regulation of the profession. Prerequisite: Admission to the MSW program or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Admission to the MSW program or consent of instructor.
